It is nice to see you responding to our signals. My name is Grobodal, and I am here to show you our wonderful world.

Great to see the old settlement thriving again. You seem to have a really positive impact on this world, so let me tell you something. If you dwell deep in the mines, you can find something vital to your progression.
Ah, the old drill. We used to build these to explore the underground of our world, but that was a long time ago.

With the school standing again, the creatures can now live an educated life. Since that's taken care of, how about a little challenge? If you can dig down to 42m in 15 minutes or less, i'll give you this relic of the old times.
You made it, amazing! Here is the relic, as I promised. It is a very old one, my ancestors used these to illuminate cave systems. I'm sure you can find a use for it.

So even in this dangerous environment you have no problem making progress. I hope my notes helped with that, even though my handwriting can be hard to read sometimes. Anyway, how about a little challenge? Think you can accumulate a total of 5 billion damage without leaving the first zone?

Seems like that was hardly a challenge at all for you. So how about another one? Crafting pickaxes is a crucial part of advancing in the mines, how far do you think you can get without crafting a single one? 40 meters sound possible to me.

Exploring the underground feels amazing. I know because I have done so myself for a very long time. I used an automated drill though, so digging down 40 meters with just a basic pickaxe is an impressive feat!
Be careful of the corruption, it seems managable at first, but don't let it get out of control. When the corruption in an enemy rises to higher levels, they become practically unbeatable.

With their own government, these creatures should be self-sufficient. But I think they would still prefer your guidance, it has worked out great so far. But let's talk about something else. To receive my relic, you need to accumulate a large amount of corrupted souls.
That should be enough souls to understand the significance of this relic. It is a heart from a very important time in our history, where we had to face a big challenge.
Nice to see potatoes grow again. The seed box seems to hold a lot of seeds from the old times. We should bring these beautiful plants to the village and spread the relaxing atmosphere there as well.
Grow the same crop multiple times, and its level increases. You can technically prestige as soon as level 4, but try reaching level 7 on a crop this time.

Plants grow exceptionally well on your farm. Growing them underground can be quite a challenge, not all types of plants respond well to artificial sunlight. You should be happy for the fertile soil and abundant daylight.

That crop was massive! With that big yield, you should have no problem unlocking more seeds. Take a total of 8 seeds from the seed box, and I'll give you a relic from an old plant that used to be very common on our planet.

This is a rotten leaf from a hazelnut tree. In autumn, these leaves used to be everywhere. Perhaps you can use it on your farm to make the soil even more fertile. Just bury it under your farm, that should do the job.
You may be wondering why everything down here is full of scrap. It's a long story about an infinite need of resources in a finite world.
When you run out of resources, it doesn't matter how powerful you are. Learn to thrive with few resources, it is an important skill to learn.
The village seems to have a different underground structure than the mines. Clean stone can be found everywhere, and not a single bit of scrap.
This is a specialized tool to break through the scrap-filled mines with ease. I have used one of these myself and can confirm their effectiveness.
Mastering your equipment can take a long time, but it is worth it. This world presents tough challenges, you'll need every bit of help you can get.
To grow such a massive plant, you must have learned about this world and adapted. That attitude will get you far in our world.
Even in the village you managed to reach new magnitudes of civilization. Trust me, the creatures are more than happy about this.
This equipment may seem advanced to you, but it is nothing compared to the tools we had available. Technology can be a massive game-changer.

These challenges have for sure been hard, but you are just at the beginning. If you can manage to reach zone 110 without ever using more than one equipment, you can have a small prize. Just to keep you motivated.
Congratulations, you definetely earned this one! At this point I can say with confidence that the Gooboo project has been nothing but successful so far!
Art, something I have not seen in a very long time. Not that I hate it, but there just hasn't been a need for physical items of decoration for a long time now.
Green, the colour of nature and life. In the old times, plants were a sign of a healthy ecosystem. As soon as the green went away, everything started going downhill.
Luckily, we don't have to worry about plants right now. We are a digital civilization, and our source of energy is not from a biological origin.
Back in the old times, we used to auction the most beautiful pieces of art for huge amounts of cash. Maybe, we can recreate this. Let's see how much cash you can get for this old vase.
That should be enough! The vase is yours, and it should be more useful to you than it is to me. Just place it next to your painting, that should help your creativity.

b: Soma de 8 partes, uma por feature/subfeature. Cada parte guarda só o seu recorde, então nunca cai. Libera features novas e {{concept:library}}.
Workers: soma do nível (até 25) dos 10 prédios de moradia
Crafters guild: milestones de crafting atingidos
A cada 10 GL: +1 {{cur:school_examPass}}. Acima de 150: bônus nos recursos do evento Snowdown.
Reiniciar uma feature trocando o progresso da run por uma moeda permanente. Cada feature tem o seu, independente das outras.
{{feat:farm}}: prestige por crop (bônus ×1.04 por nível recorde)
Upgrades de prestige e premium não resetam.
As cards selecionadas são equipadas no momento do prestige ({{concept:cards}}).

Quando uma moeda passa da capacidade, algumas continuam ganhando, mas menos. Entre 1× e 2× do cap o ganho é multiplicado pelo fator de overcap; entre 2× e 3× é multiplicado de novo pelo fator de escala, e assim por diante. Cada moeda mostra os seus fatores.
Valor = (valor inicial + soma dos efeitos "base") × produto dos efeitos "mult" + soma dos efeitos "bonus".
Depois aplica mínimo/máximo e arredondamento, se houver.
Efeitos aplicados a um grupo (ex.: Resource gain da Village) valem para todos os membros do grupo.
Cada estatística e moeda tem uma seção "Afetado por" listando todas as fontes conhecidas: upgrades, relics, cards, livros, genes, heirlooms etc.
Desce sozinho na mina e define o prestige da {{feat:mining}}. Destrava com {{upg:mining_depthDweller}} (Ore mine) e {{upg:mining_gasDweller}} (Gas giant).
Limite = profundidade máxima DESTA run × Maximum dweller depth (base 10%, máx. 50%).
Corre rápido no começo e desacelera perto do limite.
Depois do limite continua bem devagar (overcap linear).
Cristais = 7 × s × 1.15^(s/2) × multiplicador, com s = 2 × profundidade do dweller.
Gastar barras da smeltery para melhorar a picareta. Cada barra tem seu enhancement. Enquanto houver enhancements ativos não cai obsidian. Reseta no prestige.
Cada kill aumenta o combo: inimigos ficam mais fortes (ataque ×1.025, vida ×1.01 por combo) e você ganha +1.2% de bone por combo.
O boss aparece com combo = 2 × zona + 20 (reduzido por recordes acima da zona 20). Derrotar o boss avança a zona.
Drops especiais a partir da zona 21: {{cur:horde_soulCorrupted}} e chance de {{concept:heirlooms}}.
Almas por drop = 1.1^(zona−21) × (zona−20) × multiplicador, usando a zona máxima da run. O cap de almas usa o recorde de todos os tempos.
Bônus permanentes que crescem a cada cópia. Chance base 1% + 0,1% por zona acima de 30.
Destrava depois da zona 74. Equipamentos ganham mastery acima da zona 75. Mastery 1 mantém o item encontrado e mastery 3 mantém o nível no prestige.
Nível = quests de classe concluídas (boss vale 2). É a parte "Classes" do {{concept:gl}}.
Subfeature 1 da {{feat:village}} (GL 800). Cria itens com recursos; vender gera Copper coin, que vira {{cur:village_shares}} no prestige.
Cada receita tem milestones por quantidade criada (não reseta). Cada milestone vale +1 {{concept:gl}}.
Cartas de cada feature. Destrava em GL 80. Vêm de {{concept:cardpack}}.
Coleção da feature: bônus por carta diferente encontrada.
Shiny: bônus por carta shiny encontrada.
Coleção completa: bônus fixo, às vezes +1 slot.
Equipadas: efeito da carta + bônus exponencial pelo card power somado.
As cartas selecionadas só ficam equipadas no próximo prestige, e isso gasta 1 cópia de cada (precisa sobrar 1).
A seleção é zerada depois de cada prestige: selecione de novo antes do próximo.
Comprados com {{cur:gem_emerald}}; cada pack sorteia cartas de uma feature e exige um unlock.
Destrava com a relic {{relic:deckOfCards}}. Cada carta aberta tem 1,5% de chance de ser shiny. Shiny repetida vira {{cur:card_shinyDust}}.
Personagens com questlines que cruzam várias features. Cada questline termina numa relic que costuma abrir um sistema novo.
Parte da {{feat:school}} liberada pela relic {{relic:dustyBook}}. Livros aparecem conforme a parte da feature no {{concept:gl}}.
Liberado pela relic {{relic:museumKey}}. 3 pedestais; relics colocadas neles fazem os glyphs subirem de nível com o tempo.
Congelar uma feature (GL 290): ela para, mas gera moeda de prestige por dia com base no seu melhor prestige e ganha exp de cryolab.
Ativo (congelada): 20% + 1% por nível do melhor prestige por dia (Village: 8% + 0,4%).
Passivo (mesmo sem congelar): 0,5% por nível por dia.
Exp por dia = 1.015^GL × GL × 2, usando a parte do GL da feature.
Cada nível também dá ×1.15 no ganho de prestige daquela feature.
Eventos por calendário (GL 150). Grandes: Cinders (15/01), Bloom (09/03), Weather Chaos (22/05), Summer Festival (26/07), Night Hunt (04/10), Snowdown (25/11). Pequenos: Merchant, Casino, Bank.
Durante eventos grandes, {{cur:gem_topaz}} vira moeda do evento.
